examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A stacked group bound with `v-model`: one tab stop, the arrow keys move the selection, and the disabled option is skipped.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import RadioGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/radio-group'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const cycle = ref('monthly')
</script>

<template>
  <RadioGroup
    v-model="cycle"
    name="billing-cycle"
    aria-label="Billing cycle"
  >
    <RadioGroup.Item value="monthly">Monthly</RadioGroup.Item>
    <RadioGroup.Item value="yearly">Yearly, two months free</RadioGroup.Item>
    <RadioGroup.Item
      value="contract"
      disabled
    >
      Annual contract
    </RadioGroup.Item>
  </RadioGroup>
</template>

examples.name: Horizontal
examples.summary: `orientation="horizontal"` lays three short options in a row that wraps in a narrow container.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import RadioGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/radio-group'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const protocol = ref('https')
</script>

<template>
  <RadioGroup
    v-model="protocol"
    name="protocol"
    orientation="horizontal"
    aria-label="Protocol"
  >
    <RadioGroup.Item value="http">HTTP</RadioGroup.Item>
    <RadioGroup.Item value="https">HTTPS</RadioGroup.Item>
    <RadioGroup.Item value="both">Both</RadioGroup.Item>
  </RadioGroup>
</template>

examples.name: Disabled
examples.summary: `disabled` on the group disables every option and keeps the selection visible.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import RadioGroup from '@aziontech/webkit/radio-group'
  import { ref } from 'vue'

  const plan = ref('pro')
</script>

<template>
  <RadioGroup
    v-model="plan"
    name="plan"
    disabled
    aria-label="Plan"
  >
    <RadioGroup.Item value="free">Free</RadioGroup.Item>
    <RadioGroup.Item value="pro">Pro</RadioGroup.Item>
    <RadioGroup.Item value="enterprise">Enterprise</RadioGroup.Item>
  </RadioGroup>
</template>
